metadata.description: Complete timeline rules for Bangladeshi CS/AI/ML students from application to citizenship
metadata.targetProfile: Bangladeshi student, MSc/PhD in CS/AI/ML, planning 2027-2029 start, full lifecycle planning
metadata.criticalNote: Timelines are estimates based on 2026 policy. Allow 3-6 month buffer at each stage. Political changes can affect timelines significantly.

globalTimeline.typicalFullJourney: 10-18 years from application to citizenship depending on country
phases: Phase 1: Application & Admission (6-18 months before start)
Phase 4: Permanent Residency (1-5 years after employment)
bangladeshiSpecificNotes: Bangladesh passport holders require visa for all listed countries
Police clearance certificate from Bangladesh required for PR/citizenship
Financial documentation from Bangladesh banks may need apostille
English test (IELTS/TOEFL) required for most countries
No dual citizenship with Bangladesh - must consider renunciation timing

universalRules: Never let any visa/permit expire - maintain legal status continuously
Apply for next permit 3 months before current expires
PR applications: submit immediately when eligible, do not delay
Language tests: take early, retake if needed, valid scores maintained
Always have 6 months emergency fund at every stage
bangladeshiSpecific: Bangladesh has no dual citizenship - time citizenship renunciation carefully
Australia, South Korea, and some others require renunciation - major life decision
Germany, Sweden, Norway, Ireland, Netherlands allow dual - much safer
Police clearance from Bangladesh: apply 3 months in advance (processing slow)
Bangladesh passport renewal: renew before expiry even while abroad
familyRelocationTiming: Spouse: bring after PR application approved or work permit secured
Children: bring when school placement and housing secured
Parents: most countries very difficult - plan Super Visa (Canada) or extended visits
Do NOT bring family on student visa - financial strain and uncertainty too high
